name: jev-delegate
description: Asks Jev mid-turn whether what remains is the execution of a settled plan, and if so tells the main model to hand it to a subagent.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Where Jev is served from: typesafe (System One API) or cloudflare (Cloudflare AI typesafe/jev, billed through AI Gateway).

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key, or a Cloudflare API token for the cloudflare provider. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY / CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.

cloudflareAccountId.title: Cloudflare account id
cloudflareAccountId.description: Account id for the cloudflare provider. Leave unset to use CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

cloudflareGatewayId.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway id
cloudflareGatewayId.description: AI Gateway to route cloudflare requests through. Leave unset to use CLOUDFLARE_AI_GATEWAY_ID or the account's default gateway.

baseUrl.title: Endpoint override
baseUrl.description: Full request URL, replacing the provider's endpoint.

afterCalls.title: First check after this many own tool calls
afterCalls.description: Once the main loop has run this many tool calls itself in a turn (then at growing intervals), Jev is asked whether what remains is the execution of a settled plan. 0 turns the plugin off.

delegateModel.title: Model named in the nudge
delegateModel.description: The model the nudge tells the assistant to pass to the Agent tool.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: TypeSafe Jev model name. Ignored by the cloudflare provider, which always sends typesafe/jev.
